page.notes: The letter "E" at the head of the right column is a section letter and is set as its own line. The initial "E" of "Admundus" appears to be a large woodcut-style initial; the letter is likely "Ed" or "E" joined to "Admundus" (read here as "EAdmundus", the first letter being large). Some words are damaged by the scan: "statiliendo" (likely "stabiliendo" in the printed form), "Papārum", "bullas lasciuire" and "uos relatus" are uncertain. The catchword at the foot is partly illegible and is given as "exti[?]". No page number is printed.
